name: Employee Collaboration V2
collaboration_principle: 员工之间不直接抢任务；所有协作由 Commander 基于 Mission 依赖和 Runtime 状态调度。

flows.name: 内容发布协作流
steps: Knowledge Employee 准备产品事实
Content Employee 生成内容草稿
SEO Employee 检查 SEO
Knowledge QA Employee 验证事实和公开边界
Publishing Employee 检查审批和目标平台
Provider 执行 Draft-only 或经 CEO 审批后发布
Analytics Employee 读取结果
Documentation Employee 写验收报告
flows.approval_gate: Publish/Public Upload 必须 CEO 审批

flows.name: 视频发布协作流
steps: Knowledge Employee 提供产品资料
Content Employee 生成视频脚本和标题说明
Video Employee 选择素材并准备上传 payload
Security Employee 确认隐私级别和授权
Publishing Employee 调度 YouTube Provider
Analytics Employee 后续读取表现
flows.approval_gate: Public Upload 必须 CEO 审批；Private validation 可按单次授权执行

flows.name: 询盘到销售协作流
steps: CRM Employee 建立或关联 Customer Card
Knowledge Employee 提供产品事实
Sales Employee 生成英文回复草稿
Finance Employee 标记报价边界
Gmail Draft Provider 创建草稿
CEO 或人工销售确认是否发送
flows.approval_gate: Send Email 和正式报价必须人工确认

flows.name: 数据到决策协作流
steps: Analytics Employee 读取 GA4/GSC
Data Employee 校验数据口径
Marketing Employee 形成策略建议
Commander 汇总给 CEO
Documentation Employee 生成日报/周报
flows.approval_gate: 只读数据不需要审批；更改配置或广告动作需要审批
